text: Implemented LISA end to end: null_from_maps, lisa_bilateral filter spec, neuroim2/reference filter backends, empirical FDR with streaming null counts, lisa(null_spec) neurothresh_result engine, one/two-sample and GLM wrappers, scale_space_energy null_spec compatibility, validation tests, and vignette docs. Verified with devtools::test(), vignette render, R CMD build, and R CMD check (only local compiler warning).
